  try {
    final req = CreateSpeechRequest(model: 'tts-1', input: 'Hello world', voice: 'nova', responseFormat: null, speed: null);
    final apiKey = Platform.environment['API_KEY'];
      if (apiKey == null || apiKey.isEmpty) { throw StateError('API_KEY must be set'); }

    final result = await client.speech(req: req);
